description: This file defines the implementation of the WSEndpoint class template for WebSocket server/client endpoints, including connection management, message handling, event loop control, and template instantiations for various configurations.

classes.name: WSEndpoint
classes.description: Template class implementing WebSocket endpoint with connection management, message handling, and event loop control.

methods.name: WSEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WebSocket endpoint, setting up logging, handlers, and encryption.

methods.name: ~WSEndpoint
methods.description: Destructor stopping event loop and closing connection.

methods.name: closeConnection
methods.description: Closes the active WebSocket connection if open.

methods.name: startEventLoop
methods.description: Starts the WebSocket event loop in a new thread.

methods.name: stopEventLoop
methods.description: Stops the WebSocket event loop thread.

methods.name: registerHandlers
methods.description: Registers message, open, close, and fail handlers for WebSocket events.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message over the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, filtering by opcode.

methods.name: onFail
methods.description: Handles connection failure, updates authentication state.
